name: AXM Studio
notes: Full layered creative studio ported whole onto the foundation: paint/shape/tone/detail tool spine, per-layer opacity + blend modes, layer reorder + content-shift, filters incl. Polish (legibility sharpen), cut/copy/import from a sheet, atlas/spritesheet export, transparent + hi-res (2x/3x) PNG export, symmetry, palettes, presets, stickers, and an AI creative partner (optional, via AXM.ask) with the SAME tools as the human incl. erase, multi-layer and a free self-directed session. Storage via AXM.store (saveFormat 1). NOTHING was removed in the port.
